title: Missing Advertised Piece
text: Ordered this for my dad for Christmas. He received it later than date described (can give a pass on this due to Covid issues), but, there  also was no welcome letter or description of any kind. There was also no voucher or coupon or direction for ebook. We got him the Thriller Club. One book -- graphic and violent -- the other I'm not sure about but seems to open in a fantasy realm -- may flip back to traditional thriller settings. My dad is not unhappy with the gift -- he loves to read and reads voraciously and omnivorously. Still, a disappointment to us that he may not be receiving junk reading and to not have things as special as they were advertised.  Will be giving this club one or two more months before cancelling to see if improvements occur and if the selection of reading material elevates. Also will contact seller to see if we are missing something. Will update this review if so.
label: negative
